_comment: Human gate 2: the reviewed shot specification.
This file is what importSpecificationReview() accepts. It binds a full shot-spec
object to the exact measurement it approves, so it cannot be reused for another
reference or after the measurements change.
Do not hand-write it: build it with
which hashes the un-edited CV draft and refuses a spec whose transformations differ.
sourceHash = sha256 of the reference video; baseHash = the analysis base hash printed
in the blocked run's nextActions (run-report.json -> artifacts.baseHash).
reviewer and notes must be non-empty, and spec must be the whole shot-spec object.
baseHash: <64-char analysis base hash from the blocked run>
notes: <what was confirmed, what stays unresolved, e.g. copy transcribed from frames 0-58; serif face still a hypothesis>

spec._comment: the complete shot-spec object, with spec.review.status set to confirmed
